result.verdict: PRUNED: the κ-ladder's one-instanton Borel action converges (1/n, monotone) to Vol(4₁)/π ≈ 0.6461, and the finite-order estimate A_6 = 0.630346 matches the #3898 corpus tower singularity real part 0.6310 to < 0.2%. So the d↔κ bridge requires NO NEW instanton action — the action is the KNOWN Vol/π, shared across the geometric κ-ladder, the even-channel Borel plane (C1), and the corpus tower (Murakami regime). The bridge SPLITS by bar-parity: the bar-even action is Re = Vol/π (known); the bar-odd piece is the tower's Im = 0.0210 — the √3-graded Stokes normalization (matching #3916's √3-graded odd subladder) that the bridge must supply. This narrows the open keystone from 'derive a transcendental d↔κ map' to 'derive one √3-graded Stokes constant against a known action'. scope-(a): a formalize-first narrowing of the bridge hypothesis class, NOT a derivation of the bridge; the Stokes constant stays open. ħ↔2πi/N: perturbative one-instanton action only. NO fit; NO c_k wired; NO tier change.
